sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS e, AVG("budget"."Budget_invested_percent") AS m1, AVG(("budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested")) AS m2, (AVG("budget"."Budget_invested_percent") - AVG(("budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested"))) AS m3 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."School_id") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
quantities: budget.budgeted share of total budget minus invested share of total budget
why: average of invested as percent of budgeted per School (by School_id)
budgeted share of total budget - invested share of total budget: both in percent and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one school's budget in one year
average of budgeted share of total budget minus invested share of total budget per School (by School_id)
average of invested as percent of budgeted minus average of budgeted share of total budget minus invested share of total budget: both in percent, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
